reference_transcript: Good morning, doctor. I have had a sore throat, fever, and pain when swallowing for about three days. I have not had any difficulty breathing, but I feel very tired. Have you taken any medication so far, and do you have any known drug allergies? I took paracetamol five hundred milligrams twice yesterday. It helped with the fever. I do not have any known drug allergies. Your symptoms are consistent with a throat infection. I am prescribing amoxicillin five hundred milligrams three times a day for five days. You may take paracetamol five hundred milligrams when needed for fever or pain, but do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Okay. When should I come back? Drink plenty of fluids and rest. If you develop difficulty breathing, a severe rash, or your symptoms become significantly worse, seek medical attention earlier. Otherwise, arrange a follow-up in five days if the symptoms have not improved.
